## Purpose and scope
Describe the change, affected repositories/files, and scientific motivation.

## Dependency / result provenance
Upstream PRs; full old and new commit hashes; approved upstream ref; affected runs,
figures and tables; REPRODUCE.md / ASSETS.md updates. State "not applicable" when appropriate.

## Validation evidence
List exact commands, environment, observed PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT RUN,
PDF/figure inspection, and any remaining limitations. Do not treat planned runs as completed.

## Review checklist
- [ ] Changes are task-scoped; unrelated and unpublished work is preserved.
- [ ] New pins are published/reviewed and staged with their provenance.
- [ ] No secrets, raw data, weights, generated PDFs, or oversized blobs were added.
- [ ] Required checks ran; missing tools/data/permissions are stated explicitly.
- [ ] Scientific claims, citations and changed figures were reviewed.
